verdicts.evidence: The last paragraph reads "We try again after three days and email the account owner each time. After a third failed try the account moves to read-only until a payment goes through." It has no comma after "try" and doesn't say what read-only means or how to fix it.
Each of the three subheads has about the same gap above it as below it (about 30 px each side), so none sits visibly closer to its own text.
The "Remove an old card" section says a card can be removed "once another card is set as the default" and never explains how to set a default.
